d:
July 1942. At the outskirts of Stalingrad, exhausted and drained Soviet troops are fighting heavy defensive battles, suffering huge losses. The film is about a feat of ordinary soldiers, about human love to the native land, about the actual price of victory.
A screen adaptation of the novel by Mikhail Sholokhov.
Year of production: 1975
Directed by: Sergey Bondarchuk
Written by: Sergey Bondarchuk, Mikhail Sholokhov (novel)
Music: Anatoli Kroll
Director of photography: Vadim Yusov
Production designer: Feliks Yasyukevich
